metadata.title: Phase 2C.5B3 File-Channel Implementation Contract Formal Errata and Provenance Amendment
metadata.reason: Correction of historical pre-implementation over-classification. Formally segregates authentic original binary protocol parity from architectural Go implementation choices, defensive hardening, and staging path specificity.
effective_contract_rules: Base contract FILE_CHANNEL_B3_IMPLEMENTATION_CONTRACT.json remains strictly frozen and immutable to preserve pre-implementation historical provenance.
Original protocol parity claims must be strictly grounded in authentic original binary/forensic evidence.
Streaming hash accumulation and exact trigger timing are classified as IMPLEMENTATION_CHOICE and separated from static integrity check presence.
Defensive overflow abortion and early termination handling are classified as IMPLEMENTATION_CHOICE and separated from completed byte tracking.
Staging path /data/local/tmp is strictly confirmed for APK installation workflows, while generic file sink base directory is classified as IMPLEMENTATION_CHOICE.
Effective contract view is dynamically computed by combining the frozen base contract with this formal errata document.

corrections.original_claim: Streaming SHA-256 Checksum Calculation & Integrity Check: Agent computes running SHA-256 hash across incoming chunks. Upon receiving total declared bytes, computed hash is compared against metadata sha256; mismatches abort transfer (STATIC_CONFIRMED, mandatory_for_parity: true)
corrections.problem: Log strings prove an integrity check exists, but do not by themselves prove the streaming hasher implementation or the exact lifecycle trigger timing at received == declared size.
corrections.corrected_original_parity_claim: File channel implements SHA-256 integrity verification validating uploaded data against metadata sha256.
corrections.non_original_compatibility_behavior: Streaming SHA-256 accumulation, exact trigger lifecycle upon received == declared size, and hash mismatch abort transition (IMPLEMENTATION_CHOICE).
corrections.rationale: Static strings prove integrity check existence ('[FileChannel] SHA-256 integrity check passed: %s' and '[FileChannel] Upload integrity check FAILED: %v'). The streaming hasher state machine and exact lifecycle trigger timing are architectural implementation choices.

corrections.original_claim: Declared Size Accounting & Transfer Completion: Agent tracks accumulated chunk byte count against metadata size. When cumulative received bytes equal declared size, transfer completes; overflow or early termination aborts transfer (STATIC_CONFIRMED, mandatory_for_parity: true)
corrections.problem: The log string '[FileChannel] Upload finished: %s (%d bytes)' proves that upload tracks and reports completed byte count, but does not by itself prove overflow abortion, early termination abort, or duplicate metadata handling.
corrections.corrected_original_parity_claim: File upload tracks and reports completed byte count upon transfer completion.
corrections.non_original_compatibility_behavior: Defensive overflow rejection (received > declared), early DataChannel close abort, and duplicate start_upload handling (IMPLEMENTATION_CHOICE).
corrections.rationale: Tracking and logging the completed byte count is proven by binary format string, whereas defensive abortion on overflow, early closure cleanup, and duplicate metadata rejection are defensive implementation choices.

corrections.original_claim: Original Target Destination Path: Original binary targets destination directory /data/local/tmp for file staging and temp APK files (STATIC_CONFIRMED, mandatory_for_parity: true)
corrections.problem: Strings '/data/local/tmp/install_%s.apk' and '[FileChannel] Failed to copy APK to /data/local/tmp: %v' confirm /data/local/tmp as a staging location for APK installation workflows, but asserting it as the generic destination directory for every uploaded file without dataflow proof is an over-classification.
corrections.corrected_original_parity_claim: Original agent workflow uses /data/local/tmp as a confirmed staging location for uploaded APKs targeted for installation.
corrections.non_original_compatibility_behavior: Generic destination directory for all non-APK file transfers and configurable BaseDir in LocalFileSink (IMPLEMENTATION_CHOICE).
corrections.rationale: Forensic strings explicitly tie /data/local/tmp to APK staging and install copy operations. LocalFileSink configurable base directory is an implementation choice allowing test sandbox isolation.
